Privacy Policy — Email Sticky Notes

Effective Date: October 2026

Email Sticky Notes for Microsoft Outlook is designed with a privacy-first architecture. Your email content and sticky notes never leave your Microsoft 365 / Exchange mailbox or local browser storage.

1. Where Your Notes Are Stored

  • Office.js CustomProperties & RoamingSettings: Notes are stored directly inside your own Microsoft Exchange mailbox item properties and roaming settings.
  • Microsoft Graph Open Extensions (Optional): When enabled by you or your organization, notes are stored as open extensions (com.jraltd.emailNotes) on your own Exchange message objects via Microsoft Graph.

2. Zero Third-Party Data Collection

This add-in does not transmit, sell, log, or store your emails, sticky notes, or personal information on any external third-party database or analytics server.

3. Permissions Used

The add-in uses Outlook mailbox permissions solely to read the active message subject/sender context, store your sticky notes on the message, and apply the visual 📝 Sticky Note category tag in your inbox.
